title: Human A/B review for Image Review Blueprint

rubric.label: Descriptor clarity
rubric.guidance: A reviewer compares whether the static package descriptions explain the typed flow clearly.

rubric.label: Traceability
rubric.guidance: A reviewer checks whether version and provenance metadata identify the proposed change.

limitations: This scenario is a human review rubric and does not run a benchmark or workflow.
No runtime-quality, latency, throughput, or resource claim is produced.
